title: Denote

inlines.v: DENOTE, verb transitive [Latin To note or mark.] 1. To mark; to signify by a visible sign; to indicate; to express. The character X denotes multiplication. 2. To show; to betoken; to indicate; as, a quick pulse denotes fever.
